args.title: Brightline Freight — Warehouse automation in 2026
args.body:
• Brightline Freight’s latest newsletter highlights its “Warehouse automation in 2026” coverage and links to the main article and a free companion piece.
• The main article reports that autonomous carts increased warehouse pick rates by 18%, although integration took twice as long as planned.
• The companion piece says the biggest cost saving came from reducing mis-picks.
